tasks.task_name: Add taskify, task review, and complete states to the state machine
tasks.goal: The state machine includes StateTaskify, StateTaskReview, StateTaskRevision, StateTaskHumanGate, StateTasksApproved, and StateComplete with correct transitions, and StateFinalized is no longer terminal.

outputs.name: updated-types
outputs.constraints: New state constants added to iota block

acceptance: StateTaskify, StateTaskReview, StateTaskRevision, StateTaskHumanGate, StateTasksApproved, and StateComplete are defined as WorkflowState constants in types.go
workflowStateNames array includes string names for all six new states
isTerminal() returns true only for StateComplete and StateEscalated, false for StateFinalized
isTerminalWorkflowState() returns true only for StateComplete and StateEscalated

isValidTransition() allows FINALIZED -> TASKIFY, TASKIFY -> TASK_REVIEW, TASKIFY -> TASKIFY (retry), TASKIFY -> ESCALATED, TASK_REVIEW -> TASK_HUMAN_GATE, TASK_REVIEW -> TASK_REVISION, TASK_REVIEW -> ESCALATED, TASK_REVISION -> TASK_REVIEW, TASK_HUMAN_GATE -> TASKS_APPROVED, TASK_HUMAN_GATE -> TASKIFY, TASK_HUMAN_GATE -> COMPLETE, TASKS_APPROVED -> COMPLETE
StateTaskify is included in RewindableStates
go build ./... succeeds with zero errors
Existing state machine tests pass without modification
constraints: Must not change existing state transitions
Both isTerminal functions must be updated in lockstep

tasks.task_name: Add new configuration fields for dual-provider and taskify features
tasks.goal: SpecWorkflowConfig includes EnableCodexDiscovery, EnableCodexDrafting, AgentTimeoutSeconds, TaskifyMaxRetries, and TaskReviewMaxRounds with correct defaults and validation.

outputs.name: updated-config
outputs.constraints: New fields with yaml tags and defaults

acceptance: EnableCodexDiscovery defaults to false when absent from YAML
EnableCodexDrafting defaults to false when absent from YAML
AgentTimeoutSeconds defaults to 300 when absent from YAML
TaskifyMaxRetries defaults to 3 when absent from YAML
TaskReviewMaxRounds defaults to 3 when absent from YAML
ParseConfig rejects AgentTimeoutSeconds <= 0 with a validation error
ParseConfig rejects TaskifyMaxRetries <= 0 with a validation error
ParseConfig rejects TaskReviewMaxRounds <= 0 with a validation error
Existing YAML config files parse without error and existing fields retain their values
go test ./internal/specworkflow/... -run TestConfig passes

depends_on.reason: Config changes are independent of state machine changes

constraints: Existing ReviewerTimeoutSeconds must remain unchanged
New fields must have yaml struct tags matching snake_case names

tasks.task_name: Implement discovery output merge function with union-unique logic
tasks.goal: MergeDiscoveryOutputs combines two DiscoveryOutput structs using union-unique logic for all fields, with case-insensitive dedup and deterministic conflict resolution preferring Claude.

outputs.name: merged-output
outputs.constraints: Union of unique items, both problem_statements if different

acceptance: MergeDiscoveryOutputs with identical actors from both providers produces each actor once
MergeDiscoveryOutputs with non-overlapping actors produces the union of all actors
Actor dedup is case-insensitive: 'admin' and 'Admin' are treated as the same actor
When both providers have an actor with the same name, Claude's version is used
When Claude's actor description is empty but Codex's is not, Codex's description is used
When problem_statements differ, both are included with provider attribution in the output
When problem_statements are identical, a single problem_statement is returned
MergeDiscoveryOutputs with one empty output returns the other output unchanged
MergeDiscoveryOutputs with both empty outputs returns an empty output
All 14 discovery merge unit tests from the TDD plan pass

depends_on.reason: Pure function with no state machine dependencies

constraints: Conflict resolution: prefer Claude; if Claude field empty, use Codex
Case-insensitive comparison for dedup keys

tasks.task_name: Implement dual-provider discovery dispatch with parallel execution and fallback
tasks.goal: When EnableCodexDiscovery is true and Codex CLI is available, both Claude and Codex discovery agents run in parallel; when one fails the survivor is used; when both fail the workflow escalates.

inputs.name: config
inputs.constraints: EnableCodexDiscovery may be true or false

outputs.name: discovery-files
outputs.constraints: Per-provider versioned filenames when dual-provider active

acceptance: With EnableCodexDiscovery=true and Codex available, both agents are dispatched in parallel
Output files are named discovery-output-claude-v{N}.json and discovery-output-codex-v{N}.json when dual-provider is active
When both agents succeed, MergeDiscoveryOutputs is called and discovery-output-merged-v{N}.json is written
When Codex fails, Claude's output is used as sole discovery output with a log entry identifying the failure
When Codex CLI is not on PATH, falls back to Claude-only with log entry 'Codex CLI not available, falling back to Claude-only discovery'
When both agents fail, workflow escalates with combined failure reason
With EnableCodexDiscovery=false, only Claude runs producing discovery-output.json (current behavior)
AgentTimeoutSeconds from config is applied to each agent independently
constraints: Must not modify existing single-provider discovery path when feature is disabled
Codex availability check must be done before dispatch

tasks.task_name: Implement dual-provider drafting dispatch with combine and fallback
tasks.goal: When EnableCodexDrafting is true and Codex CLI is available, both Claude and Codex drafters run in parallel; a Claude reviser combines successful outputs; single-provider fallback works when one fails.

inputs.name: config
inputs.constraints: EnableCodexDrafting may be true or false

outputs.name: drafter-files
outputs.constraints: Per-provider versioned filenames when dual-provider active

acceptance: With EnableCodexDrafting=true and Codex available, both drafters are dispatched in parallel
Output files are named drafter-output-claude-v{N}.json and drafter-output-codex-v{N}.json
When both succeed, a Claude reviser combines them into drafter-output-combined-v{N}.json
When the combine reviser fails, drafts are concatenated with attribution headers as fallback
When one drafter fails, the surviving draft is used directly (no combine step), with UI notice and log entry
When both drafters fail, workflow escalates with combined failure reason
With EnableCodexDrafting=false, only Claude runs producing drafter-output.json (current behavior)
When Codex CLI is not on PATH, falls back to Claude-only with log entry
constraints: Only Claude is used for the combine/revision step, never Codex
Must not modify existing single-provider drafting path when feature is disabled

tasks.task_name: Implement task graph JSON schema and DAG validation
tasks.goal: ValidateTaskGraph checks a task graph file for structural correctness (required fields, types, non-empty tasks, kebab-case IDs, valid priority) and DAG integrity (no cycles, no dangling references, no self-references).
acceptance: A valid task graph with version, non-empty tasks, kebab-case IDs, all required fields, and valid DAG passes with zero errors
Missing version field returns error 'version required'
Empty tasks array returns error 'at least one task required'
Non-kebab-case task_id (e.g. 'MyTask') returns error identifying the invalid ID
Duplicate task_ids return error identifying the duplicates
Missing goal field returns error identifying the task
Invalid priority value (e.g. 'urgent') returns error listing valid values
Empty acceptance array returns error identifying the task
Circular dependency (task-a -> task-b -> task-a) returns error 'cycle detected'
Dangling depends_on reference returns error identifying the missing task ID
Self-referencing depends_on returns error identifying the self-reference
Three-node cycle (a -> b -> c -> a) returns error 'cycle detected'
All 14 task graph validation unit tests from the TDD plan pass

depends_on.reason: Pure validation logic with no state machine dependencies

constraints: Schema file at .tasks/task-graph-schema.json is authoritative
Priority values: critical, high, medium, low (case-insensitive)

tasks.task_name: Implement taskify stage orchestration with retry logic
tasks.goal: The handleTaskify function dispatches Claude CLI with /taskify skill, validates the output against the task graph schema, retries with validation errors on failure, and escalates when retries are exhausted.
acceptance: handleTaskify dispatches Claude CLI with /taskify skill and spec-final.md content
Human comments from human-comments.json are included in the prompt via <human_feedback> block
When output passes schema and DAG validation, workflow transitions to StateTaskReview
When output fails validation, taskify is re-dispatched with validation errors in the prompt
When .tasks/{feature}.task.json does not exist after a run, this is treated as a validation failure triggering retry
When TaskifyMaxRetries attempts all fail, workflow transitions to StateEscalated with validation errors as reason
Validation errors and retry status are emitted as UI events and logged
constraints: Only Claude CLI is used for taskify dispatch (not Codex)
Must include validation errors from previous attempt in retry prompt

tasks.task_name: Implement dual-provider task review with finding merge and severity routing
tasks.goal: The handleTaskReview function dispatches Claude and Codex task reviewers in parallel, merges findings using the existing dedup algorithm, and routes to StateTaskRevision on CRITICAL/MAJOR findings or StateTaskHumanGate on minor-only findings.
acceptance: Both Claude and Codex task reviewers are dispatched in parallel with AgentTimeoutSeconds timeout
Findings are merged using the same dedup algorithm as MergeReviewerOutputs (section + category + severity key)
Provider attribution is preserved in merged findings
CRITICAL or MAJOR findings route to StateTaskRevision when rounds remain
MINOR or OBSERVATION-only findings route to StateTaskHumanGate
When TaskReviewMaxRounds is reached, findings pass to StateTaskHumanGate regardless of severity
When one reviewer fails, survivor's findings are used with a reduced-coverage notice
When both reviewers fail, workflow escalates
Findings file is named task-findings-round-{N}.json with incrementing round counter
constraints: Reuse existing MergeFindings dedup algorithm from merge.go
Round counter is per-stage, independent of other counters

tasks.task_name: Implement automated task graph revision stage
tasks.goal: The handleTaskRevision function dispatches a Claude revision agent with current task graph and findings, re-validates the revised output, and transitions back to StateTaskReview.

outputs.name: revised-task-graph
outputs.constraints: Updated task graph conforming to schema

acceptance: handleTaskRevision dispatches a Claude revision agent with the task revision prompt template
The prompt includes the current task graph JSON, merged review findings, and human comments
The revised task graph is validated against the schema before transitioning to StateTaskReview
If revision output fails validation, the validation error is logged and the workflow escalates
StateTaskRevision transitions to StateTaskReview on success
constraints: Only Claude is used for revision (not Codex)
Must re-validate output before transition

tasks.task_name: Implement task human gate with approve, correct, and skip actions
tasks.goal: StateTaskHumanGate supports three actions: Approve (persist tasks + attempt taskval --create-beads), Correct (fresh /taskify re-run with feedback), and Skip (transition to StateComplete).
acceptance: Approve action persists .tasks/{feature}.task.json and transitions through StateTasksApproved to StateComplete
Approve action attempts taskval --create-beads; on success Beads IDs are logged
When taskval is unavailable on approve, a UI warning 'taskval unavailable -- tasks saved but Beads not created' is surfaced and workflow proceeds to StateComplete
When taskval partially succeeds, a warning with count is surfaced and workflow proceeds to StateComplete
Correct action with feedback persists comment to human-comments.json and dispatches fresh /taskify re-run with <human_feedback> block
Correct action transitions to StateTaskify, then output is validated and transitions to StateTaskReview
Skip action transitions directly to StateComplete without creating tasks, with log entry 'Task creation skipped by human'
Comments on any action are persisted to human-comments.json with gate='TASK_HUMAN_GATE'
constraints: taskval unavailability must not block workflow progression
Comment persistence must happen before gate channel is signaled

tasks.task_name: Implement versioned file naming with per-stage counters
tasks.goal: All dual-provider output files follow the naming convention {output}-{provider}-v{N}.{ext} with per-stage version counters that increment on rewind and preserve prior files.
acceptance: Discovery outputs are named discovery-output-{provider}-v{N}.json when dual-provider is active
Drafting outputs are named drafter-output-{provider}-v{N}.json when dual-provider is active
Combined draft is named drafter-output-combined-v{N}.json
Task review findings are named task-findings-round-{N}.json
Version counter increments when a stage re-runs (e.g., after correction at gate)
Previous versioned files are never deleted on rewind
Single-provider mode uses current unversioned filenames (discovery-output.json, drafter-output.json)
constraints: Version counters are per-stage, not global
No file deletion on rewind

tasks.task_name: Implement append-only comment protocol for all gates including corruption detection
tasks.goal: All gates persist comments to human-comments.json in append-only fashion with gate name, action, text, and timestamp; comments survive rewind; corrupted JSON triggers escalation.
acceptance: Comments are appended to human-comments.json with gate, action, comment text, and ISO 8601 timestamp
Existing comments in human-comments.json are preserved (append-only, never overwritten)
Comments survive state rewind (file is never truncated or deleted)
When human-comments.json contains invalid JSON, the orchestrator escalates with reason 'human-comments.json is corrupted'
Comments are included in agent prompts via <human_feedback> block with priority instruction
TASK_HUMAN_GATE comments follow the same protocol as existing gates
constraints: Append-only: entries are never deleted from human-comments.json
Corruption must escalate, not silently discard

tasks.task_name: Update HUMAN_GATE_1 to show dual-provider discovery outputs side-by-side
tasks.goal: HUMAN_GATE_1 presents both Claude and Codex discovery outputs for side-by-side comparison with checkboxes to select one or both, plus a comment field, when dual-provider discovery is active.

outputs.name: gate-request-event
outputs.constraints: Includes both provider outputs as separate payloads

acceptance: Gate request event includes both claude and codex discovery output files as separate payloads
When dual-provider discovery produced merged output, the UI data includes checkboxes for provider selection
A comment field is available in the gate data
When single-provider discovery was used, the existing gate behavior is unchanged
When one provider failed, a failure notice is included in the gate data
constraints: Must not break existing HUMAN_GATE_1 behavior for single-provider mode

tasks.task_name: Update HUMAN_GATE_2 to show combined or single draft with failure notices
tasks.goal: HUMAN_GATE_2 displays the combined draft when both drafters succeed, or the single surviving draft with a failure notice when one drafter fails.

outputs.name: gate-request-event
outputs.constraints: Draft content plus optional failure notice

acceptance: When a combined draft exists, HUMAN_GATE_2 shows drafter-output-combined-v{N}.json for review
When only Claude's draft exists (Codex failed), a failure notice is visible in the gate data
A comment field is available
When single-provider drafting was used, the existing gate behavior is unchanged
constraints: Must not break existing HUMAN_GATE_2 behavior for single-provider mode

tasks.task_name: Implement rewind from StateComplete to StateTaskify
tasks.goal: The Request Revision action from StateComplete rewinds to StateTaskify with the user's comment persisted, preserving existing task files.
acceptance: Request Revision from StateComplete transitions workflow to StateTaskify
The user's comment is persisted to human-comments.json before state transition
Existing .tasks/{feature}.task.json files are preserved (not deleted) on rewind
New taskify round begins with incremented version counter
StateTaskify is present in RewindableStates
constraints: No file deletion on rewind
Comment must be persisted before state change

tasks.task_name: Write regression tests and end-to-end integration tests
tasks.goal: Regression tests confirm existing behavior is unchanged with dual-provider features disabled, and E2E tests verify the full workflow INIT through COMPLETE with all features enabled.
acceptance: TestRegression_FullWorkflowNoCodex passes: full INIT -> FINALIZED -> TASKIFY -> COMPLETE with Codex disabled produces identical output files and transitions as current main (up to FINALIZED)
TestRegression_ExistingReviewUnchanged passes: dual-provider spec review works identically to before
TestE2E_DualDiscoveryDraftingTaskify passes: full workflow with all dual-provider features enabled completes INIT -> COMPLETE

TestE2E_TaskReviewRevisionLoop passes: task review dispatches dual reviewers, CRITICAL findings route to TASK_REVISION, revised graph transitions back to TASK_REVIEW, and max rounds routes to TASK_HUMAN_GATE
All 64 tests from the TDD plan pass with zero failures
constraints: Regression tests must verify identical behavior to current main branch
E2E tests must cover the complete state machine path
